title: Run one Codex request
responsibility: Runs one ephemeral Codex turn with the requested model, forwards public results and closes the connection afterward.

inputs.name: codexTurn.command
inputs.description: The executable command and argument list used to start the Codex app-server connection.

inputs.name: codexTurn.turn
inputs.description: A TurnOptions request supplies the model, effort, working directory, prompt, access mode, abort signal and callbacks for one ephemeral OpenAI turn. Read-only access selects the read-only sandbox and write access selects danger-full-access; a truthy reference is added as a local image, callbacks receive nonempty agent text, image-generation status and file-change paths, and the declared image flag is unused.

inputs.name: codexTurn.queue
inputs.description: An optional ResourceQueueService passed to managedAgentTurn for this request; if omitted, this function passes no explicit queue.

outputs.name: codexTurn
outputs.description: The promise resolves with joined nonempty agent-message text, the model reported for the started thread, and image-generation items. Nonempty text, image-generation status and file-change paths are forwarded to callbacks, and the RPC connection is disposed when the turn finishes.

errors.name: Codex RPC startup or turn failure
errors.description: Rejects when RPC startup or a request fails, the started model or provider does not match the request, a non-retrying server error arrives, the terminal turn status is not completed, or the turn exceeds fifteen minutes.

errors.name: RunCancelled
errors.description: Rejects when the abort signal is set after RPC startup or fires during the turn; during an active turn the adapter attempts a best-effort interrupt before rejecting.
